comment: The upper bound of the delay clamp in process() is written as DELAY_MEMORY_SIZE*args.sampleRate — three times the sample rate rather than three seconds — so the delay total is effectively unclamped at the top. The ring buffer is only 3 seconds long, and a delay total past 3 seconds indexes it modulo its length, giving a delay of the wrong length rather than the maximum. The maker's README does not mention this. The README also notes that pressing or holding a KILL button produces a short click, which the source's own comments attribute to the signal being crushed to zero in one frame.
